title: LifecycleAndSafetyGate
description: Lifecycle vocabulary plus the SafetyGate wording contract. Formalizes qeeg safety_gate and the blocked_* status family, and encodes forbidden-claim guardrails so Lab/recovered methods are never presented as stable/clinical.
